cmd.does: Adds a firewall rule, Minecraft server (Rig), that lets other computers on private networks (like your home's) connect to TCP port 25565. Undo deletes the rule.
cmd.run:
if (Get-NetFirewallRule -Name 'Rig-935f58b1' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { throw 'Rig already added this rule, so there is nothing to change.' }
New-NetFirewallRule -Profile Private -Direction Inbound -Action Allow -Name 'Rig-935f58b1' -DisplayName 'Minecraft server (Rig)' -Protocol TCP -LocalPort 25565 | Out-Null

note: the firewall shorthand: a port for private networks

cmd.does: Adds a firewall rule, Game (Rig), that lets other computers on public networks (like a café's Wi-Fi) connect to UDP ports 27015, 27016. Undo deletes the rule. Anyone on the same public network could reach it, so this always gets Rig's strongest check.
cmd.run:
if (Get-NetFirewallRule -Name 'Rig-a5a970a7' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { throw 'Rig already added this rule, so there is nothing to change.' }
New-NetFirewallRule -Profile Public -Direction Inbound -Action Allow -Name 'Rig-a5a970a7' -DisplayName 'Game (Rig)' -Protocol UDP -LocalPort 27015, 27016 | Out-Null

note: the firewall shorthand: public networks are tier 3

cmd.does: Adds a firewall rule, No SMB (Rig), that stops other computers on public networks (like a café's Wi-Fi) connecting to TCP port 445. Undo deletes the rule.
cmd.run:
if (Get-NetFirewallRule -Name 'Rig-83594996' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { throw 'Rig already added this rule, so there is nothing to change.' }
New-NetFirewallRule -Profile Public -Direction Inbound -Action Block -Name 'Rig-83594996' -DisplayName 'No SMB (Rig)' -Protocol TCP -LocalPort 445 | Out-Null

note: the firewall shorthand: a block rule may name a remote-access port
